PlatformPolicy.title: PlatformPolicy
PlatformPolicy.description: Global EdTech platform settings controlled by the Owner/Super Admin.

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin who updated the policy.

defaultStudentQuota.description: Default evaluation quota assigned to new students.

retentionDays.description: Number of days student evaluation data is retained on the platform.

allowStudentUploads.description: Whether students are currently permitted to run evaluations.

platformBanner.description: Announcement or rule banner displayed to all logged-in students.

instituteName.description: Custom coaching or institute name displayed on downloaded PDFs, scorecards, and shared reports.

instituteTagline.description: Custom coaching tagline, website, or contact info displayed on downloaded PDFs and shared reports.

maxPages10Marker.description: Maximum pages allowed per copy for a 10-marker question (default 4).

maxPages15Marker.description: Maximum pages allowed per copy for a 15-marker question (default 5).

ownerWhatsappNumber.description: Optional WhatsApp number for student quota upgrade requests.

ownerUpiId.description: Optional UPI ID for student quota upgrade payments.

paymentApprovalMode.description: Whether student UPI UTR submissions auto-approve quota immediately or wait for Owner 1-click approval.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

StudentProfile.title: StudentProfile
StudentProfile.description: Registered user/student profile with role, access status, evaluation quota, and usage count.

displayName.description: Full name of the student or evaluator.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

quotaLimit.description: Maximum number of copies this student is allowed to evaluate.

usedCount.description: Number of copies evaluated by this student so far.

joinedAt.description: ISO date-time when the student joined.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile update.

UserSyncConfig.title: UserSyncConfig
UserSyncConfig.description: Stores cloud-synced prompt slots, active slot ID, AI model settings, rubric rules, and model answer presets.

ownerId.description: The UID of the authenticated owner.

activeSlotId.description: Currently active system prompt slot ID (1 to 5).

promptSlots.description: Map of the 5 system prompt slots (slot_1 through slot_5).

modelSettings.description: Map of model cascade, strictness, rubric weights, presets, and evaluation preferences.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last sync.

EvaluationRecord.title: EvaluationRecord
EvaluationRecord.description: Stores a single evaluated UPSC Mains copy scorecard, 4-pillar rubric breakdown, and red-pen margin annotations.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns this evaluation record.

studentName.description: Name of the student whose copy was evaluated.

subject.description: Subject or paper name (e.g., GS-1, GS-2, Essay).

obtainedMarks.description: Total marks obtained by the student.

evalData.description: Structured evaluation result map including rubric_breakdown, question_analysis, word_count, and page annotations.

evaluatedAt.description: ISO timestamp string when the evaluation was completed.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last record update.

LearningRecord.title: LearningRecord
LearningRecord.description: Stores human evaluator corrections over AI evaluations for pattern analysis and prompt training.

ownerId.description: The UID of the evaluator who logged this correction.

studentName.description: Student name associated with the corrected copy.

logData.description: Structured diff map containing originalEval and correctedEval.

loggedAt.description: ISO timestamp string when the learning log was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

QuotaUpgradeRequest.title: QuotaUpgradeRequest
QuotaUpgradeRequest.description: Stores a student UPI payment and 12-digit UTR quota upgrade request for Auto-Verification or Owner 1-Click Approval.

FeedbackReport.title: FeedbackReport
FeedbackReport.description: Stores user feedback on evaluation suggestions ({evaluationId, section, note}).

/platform_settings/{configId}.description: Global platform rules, default student quota, and retention policy managed by the Owner.

/student_profiles/{userId}.description: Registered student and evaluator profiles managed by the Owner.

/quota_requests/{requestId}.description: Student UPI payment and UTR quota upgrade requests.

/feedback/{feedbackId}.description: User-submitted feedback reports on evaluation sections.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Trusted admin role registry managed by the Super Admin.

/user_configs/{userId}.description: Per-user cloud configuration document storing prompt slots, model settings, and presets.

/user_configs/{userId}/evaluations/{eval.description: Subcollection of evaluated student copy scorecards and annotations belonging to the user.

/user_configs/{userId}/learning_logs/{lo.description: Subcollection of AI learning database correction logs belonging to the user.
